product_js.description:
Embrace your passion for baseball with the Jeminise Personalized Baseball Comforter Set. This bedding set offers a unique way to celebrate your favorite sport while providing a comfortable and stylish addition to any bedroom. Perfect for baseball players, fans, or anyone who loves the game, this set combines personalized charm with cozy comfort.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Ideal for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating determination and passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques to hold dye and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Microfiber Filling: Whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier after washing.
  • Customization: Features options for personalized text inputs to make it uniquely yours.
